categories.main_business_segments: Ares Management Corporation operates through four primary business segments: Credit, Real Assets, Private Equity, and Secondaries. The Credit Group is the largest, managing a broad range of credit strategies including direct lending, liquid and alternative credit, and opportunistic credit. The Real Assets Group focuses on real estate and infrastructure equity and debt investments. The Private Equity Group targets growth buyouts and structured equity investments, while the Secondaries Group invests in secondary markets across private equity, real estate, infrastructure, and credit. Other businesses include insurance solutions, SPAC sponsorship, and venture capital initiatives.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Ares leverages a disciplined, credit-oriented investment philosophy supported by proprietary research across over 55 industries and a collaborative, integrated investment platform. The firm utilizes rigorous due diligence, fundamental credit analysis, and financial modeling to assess risk and value. Its investment process is decentralized but features overlapping investment committee membership to ensure consistency and knowledge sharing. Ares also employs direct origination capabilities, especially in credit and real estate, and integrates ESG considerations into its investment process.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ares serves a diverse investor base comprising approximately 2,700 direct institutional relationships—including pension funds, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, banks, endowments, and foundations—as well as a significant and growing retail/wealth management clientele. Its products are distributed through institutional channels, intermediaries, and a dedicated wealth management platform, with end markets spanning North America, Europe, APAC, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: Ares operates globally with over 35 offices in more than 15 countries, and manages investments across North America, Europe, APAC, and Latin America. The firm has a strong presence in the U.S. and Europe, with expanding operations in APAC and Latin America, including recent acquisitions to bolster its real estate and infrastructure capabilities in Mexico and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ares acts as a financial intermediary and asset manager, operating downstream in the financial services supply chain. It sources, structures, and manages investments on behalf of its clients, providing capital solutions to borrowers, portfolio companies, and real asset owners, while also offering investment products to institutional and retail investors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Ares’ strategic priorities include expanding its product offerings, enhancing global distribution, increasing perpetual capital, and investing in technology and operational infrastructure. The firm emphasizes innovation in alternative credit, climate infrastructure, and digital/AI-driven investment solutions, and is committed to ESG integration and responsible investment. Strategic acquisitions and partnerships are also key to its growth strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Ares generates revenue primarily through management fees based on assets under management (AUM), incentive fees and carried interest tied to fund performance, and returns on its own capital invested in its funds. Additional revenue streams include fee-related performance revenues from perpetual capital vehicles, sub-advisory fees, and, to a lesser extent, transaction and advisory fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ares competes with global alternative asset managers such as Blackstone, Apollo, KKR, Carlyle, and Brookfield, as well as traditional asset managers, banks, and specialized funds. It is positioned as a market leader in credit and direct lending, with significant scale and expertise across multiple asset classes. The firm differentiates itself through its integrated platform, flexible capital solutions, and strong investment performance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, Ares managed $484.4 billion in AUM, up from $82 billion a decade earlier, reflecting a 27% five-year and 19% ten-year CAGR. The firm raised $92.7 billion in new capital in 2024 and deployed $106.7 billion, demonstrating robust growth and scale. Its management fees are largely derived from long-dated or perpetual capital, providing stable and recurring revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ares emphasizes its comprehensive multi-asset expertise, flexible capital deployment, and proprietary market intelligence as key differentiators. The firm’s collaborative culture, rigorous investment approach, and robust sourcing model enable it to deliver strong risk-adjusted returns through market cycles. Its integrated platform, scale, and commitment to ESG and innovation further enhance its value proposition to investors seeking diversified, high-performing alternative investments.
